name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.home.view.ShareQRActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens this page from the home sharing entry. It builds a referral QR code from the user's invite code, loads share images, and lets the user save or share the result.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the referral QR and image-sharing flow.
